nusmp.skill.book_soul.description: A grimoire of Soul: pale soul fire and hollow-eyed spirits, the soul as something that can be struck, drained and harvested. Every cast puts the Spirit Raiment on you for five seconds, and every page pairs a blow to the body with Spiritual Damage. Lucius's Paladin pages keep their place. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_bolt: Soul Flame Bolt: an orb of soul fire that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets, hurts the body and the soul, and drains a little of the foe's magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_cut: Soul Sever: a line drawn straight ahead through every foe on it, hurting body and soul and draining their magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_field: Soul Vortex: a field laid at the aimed point for five seconds. Every second foes inside take body and spiritual damage, are slowed and have magicules drained to you.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_domain: Soul Release: a great burst of souls around you. Foes take body and spiritual damage and are weakened; allies are healed a tenth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_soul.attribute_guard: Spirit Mantle: Absorption, Regeneration, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Spirit Raiment for as long.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_wisps: Soul Wisps: three soul spirits circle you for twenty seconds and lunge at any foe within ten blocks, biting for body and spiritual damage.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_bind: Soul Bind: the foe in your sights is struck three times a second apart for body and spiritual damage, weakened and made to glow, and you recover health with each pulse.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_harvest: Soul Harvest: for ten seconds every foe that dies within sixteen blocks returns a share of your magicules and health (the first six souls).
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_ascension: Soul Ascension: three wisps rise round you and detonate after two seconds, hurting body and soul every foe near each of them, and you recover a share of your health.
